title: Use foveated streaming to bring immersive content to visionOS
description: Find out how foveated streaming delivers remotely rendered scenes to Apple Vision Pro in full fidelity. Explore how this framework combines native visionOS capabilities with third-party streaming technologies completely wirelessly, demonstrated using an OpenXR scene and NVIDIA CloudXR. Learn about the FoveatedStreaming framework, integration with the NVIDIA CloudXR SDK, and how dynamically foveated streaming provides benefits while still preserving privacy.
